name: harness-runtime
description: Shared Claude runtime adapter: normalises function-hook events into ClaudeRuntimeEvent, exposes $.runtime (emit bus, supports, judge, snapshot) to other plugins, and writes a JSONL event log

judgeBackend.description: Semantic judgment backend for $.runtime.judge: stub (deterministic rules), model (the session's small model via $.model.complete), jev (TypeSafe System One via $.http.fetch; needs typesafeApiKey)
judgeBackend.title: Judge backend

typesafeApiKey.description: TypeSafe API key for the jev judge backend
typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key

eventLogDir.description: Directory for the normalised JSONL event log (absolute path; empty = <claude home>/mods/state/events/)
eventLogDir.title: Event log directory
